abbott_smith_html:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.
__4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
__(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.;
__(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
__II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
__1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
__2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
__3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19.
__4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al.
__5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
__(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al;
__(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
__(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
__6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al.
__7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al.
__8. Ellipses;
__(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
__(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

strongs_1890.derivation: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: am, have been, X it is I, was

occurrences.bsb: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
occurrences.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

occurrences.bsb: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
occurrences.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

occurrences.bsb: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

occurrences.bsb: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”
occurrences.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

occurrences.bsb: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.
occurrences.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

occurrences.bsb: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

occurrences.bsb: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
occurrences.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

occurrences.bsb: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
occurrences.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

occurrences.bsb: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
occurrences.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

occurrences.bsb: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
occurrences.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

occurrences.bsb: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
occurrences.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

occurrences.bsb: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

occurrences.bsb: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
occurrences.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

occurrences.bsb: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

occurrences.bsb: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

occurrences.bsb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

occurrences.bsb: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

occurrences.bsb: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
occurrences.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

occurrences.bsb: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
occurrences.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:

occurrences.bsb: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
occurrences.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

occurrences.bsb: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

occurrences.bsb: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
occurrences.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

occurrences.bsb: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
occurrences.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

occurrences.bsb: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
occurrences.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

occurrences.bsb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
occurrences.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

occurrences.bsb: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
occurrences.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

occurrences.bsb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
occurrences.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

occurrences.bsb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

occurrences.bsb: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
occurrences.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

occurrences.bsb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
occurrences.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

occurrences.bsb: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
occurrences.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

occurrences.bsb: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
occurrences.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

occurrences.bsb: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
occurrences.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

occurrences.bsb: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
occurrences.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

occurrences.bsb: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
occurrences.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

occurrences.bsb: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
occurrences.kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

occurrences.bsb: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
occurrences.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

occurrences.bsb: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
occurrences.kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

occurrences.bsb: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
occurrences.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

occurrences.bsb: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
occurrences.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

occurrences.bsb: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
occurrences.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

occurrences.bsb: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
occurrences.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

occurrences.bsb: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
occurrences.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

occurrences.bsb: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
occurrences.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

occurrences.bsb: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
occurrences.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

occurrences.bsb: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
occurrences.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

occurrences.bsb: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
occurrences.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

occurrences.bsb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
occurrences.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

occurrences.bsb: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
occurrences.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

occurrences.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
occurrences.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
occurrences.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

occurrences.bsb: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
occurrences.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

occurrences.bsb: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

occurrences.bsb: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
occurrences.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

occurrences.bsb: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
occurrences.kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

occurrences.bsb: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

occurrences.bsb: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
occurrences.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

occurrences.bsb: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
occurrences.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

occurrences.bsb: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
occurrences.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

occurrences.bsb: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
occurrences.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

occurrences.bsb: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
occurrences.kjv: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that One greater than the temple is here.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

occurrences.bsb: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

occurrences.bsb: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

occurrences.bsb: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
occurrences.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

occurrences.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
occurrences.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

occurrences.bsb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
occurrences.kjv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

occurrences.bsb: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
occurrences.kjv: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

occurrences.bsb: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
occurrences.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

occurrences.bsb: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

occurrences.bsb: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
occurrences.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

occurrences.bsb: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
occurrences.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

occurrences.bsb: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
occurrences.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

occurrences.bsb: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
occurrences.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

occurrences.bsb: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”
occurrences.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

occurrences.bsb: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man took and planted in his field.
occurrences.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

occurrences.bsb: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
occurrences.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

occurrences.bsb: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
occurrences.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

occurrences.bsb: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
occurrences.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

occurrences.bsb: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
occurrences.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

occurrences.bsb: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
occurrences.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

occurrences.bsb: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
occurrences.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

occurrences.bsb: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

occurrences.bsb: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

occurrences.bsb: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
occurrences.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

occurrences.bsb: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
occurrences.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

occurrences.bsb: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
occurrences.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

occurrences.bsb: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
occurrences.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

occurrences.bsb: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
occurrences.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

occurrences.bsb: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

occurrences.bsb: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
occurrences.kjv: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

occurrences.bsb: About five thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
occurrences.kjv: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

occurrences.bsb: After He had dismissed them, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
occurrences.kjv: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

occurrences.bsb: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
occurrences.kjv: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

occurrences.bsb: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.
occurrences.kjv: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
occurrences.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

occurrences.bsb: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
occurrences.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

occurrences.bsb: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”
occurrences.kjv: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

occurrences.bsb: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

occurrences.bsb: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
occurrences.kjv: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.

occurrences.bsb: A total of four thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
occurrences.kjv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
occurrences.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar–jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
occurrences.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

occurrences.bsb: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
occurrences.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Then He admonished the disciples not to tell anyone that He was the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
occurrences.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

occurrences.bsb: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
occurrences.kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

occurrences.bsb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

occurrences.bsb: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
occurrences.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

occurrences.bsb: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
occurrences.kjv: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
occurrences.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

occurrences.bsb: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
occurrences.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
occurrences.kjv: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

occurrences.bsb: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
occurrences.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

occurrences.bsb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

occurrences.bsb: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
occurrences.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

occurrences.bsb: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
occurrences.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

occurrences.bsb: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
occurrences.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

occurrences.bsb: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

occurrences.bsb: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

occurrences.bsb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
occurrences.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

occurrences.bsb: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
occurrences.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

occurrences.bsb: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

occurrences.bsb: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
occurrences.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

occurrences.bsb: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”
occurrences.kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

occurrences.bsb: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

occurrences.bsb: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
occurrences.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

occurrences.bsb: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
occurrences.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

occurrences.bsb: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
occurrences.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

occurrences.bsb: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
occurrences.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

occurrences.bsb: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
occurrences.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

occurrences.bsb: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
occurrences.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

occurrences.bsb: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
occurrences.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

occurrences.bsb: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
occurrences.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: For many are called, but few are chosen.”
occurrences.kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.

occurrences.bsb: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
occurrences.kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
occurrences.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

occurrences.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

occurrences.bsb: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
occurrences.kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

occurrences.bsb: This is the first and greatest commandment.
occurrences.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.

occurrences.bsb: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

occurrences.bsb: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
occurrences.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

occurrences.bsb: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
occurrences.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

occurrences.bsb: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

occurrences.bsb: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

occurrences.bsb: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
occurrences.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

occurrences.bsb: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
occurrences.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
occurrences.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
occurrences.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

occurrences.bsb: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
occurrences.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

occurrences.bsb: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

occurrences.bsb: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
occurrences.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

occurrences.bsb: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

occurrences.bsb: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unseen from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
occurrences.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

occurrences.bsb: So if they tell you, ‘There He is, in the wilderness,’ do not go out, or, ‘Here He is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

occurrences.bsb: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

occurrences.bsb: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
occurrences.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

occurrences.bsb: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

occurrences.bsb: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

occurrences.bsb: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
occurrences.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

occurrences.bsb: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

occurrences.bsb: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

occurrences.bsb: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
occurrences.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

occurrences.bsb: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
occurrences.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
occurrences.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
occurrences.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
occurrences.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
occurrences.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

occurrences.bsb: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
occurrences.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

occurrences.bsb: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
occurrences.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

occurrences.bsb: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
occurrences.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

occurrences.bsb: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after Me.’
occurrences.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

occurrences.bsb: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
occurrences.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

occurrences.bsb: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
occurrences.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

occurrences.bsb: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

occurrences.bsb: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.”
occurrences.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

occurrences.bsb: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
occurrences.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

occurrences.bsb: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

occurrences.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
occurrences.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

occurrences.bsb: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
occurrences.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

occurrences.bsb: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
occurrences.kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: What do you think?” “He deserves to die,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

occurrences.bsb: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
occurrences.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

occurrences.bsb: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
occurrences.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

occurrences.bsb: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
occurrences.kjv: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

occurrences.bsb: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said, “It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
occurrences.kjv: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, who questioned Him: “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

occurrences.bsb: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
occurrences.kjv: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

occurrences.bsb: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
occurrences.kjv: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

occurrences.bsb: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
occurrences.kjv: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

occurrences.bsb: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

occurrences.bsb: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
occurrences.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

occurrences.bsb: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
occurrences.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
occurrences.kjv: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

occurrences.bsb: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
occurrences.kjv: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

occurrences.bsb: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
occurrences.kjv: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.

occurrences.bsb: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
occurrences.kjv: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

occurrences.bsb: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
occurrences.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

occurrences.bsb: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
occurrences.kjv: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

occurrences.bsb: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
occurrences.kjv: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

occurrences.bsb: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
occurrences.kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

occurrences.bsb: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
occurrences.kjv: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
occurrences.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

occurrences.bsb: And he proclaimed: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
occurrences.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

occurrences.bsb: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
occurrences.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
occurrences.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

occurrences.bsb: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
occurrences.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

occurrences.bsb: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
occurrences.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

occurrences.bsb: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
occurrences.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

occurrences.bsb: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

occurrences.bsb: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
occurrences.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

occurrences.bsb: and the whole town gathered at the door.
occurrences.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

occurrences.bsb: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
occurrences.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

occurrences.bsb: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
occurrences.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

occurrences.bsb: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
occurrences.kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

occurrences.bsb: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
occurrences.kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

occurrences.bsb: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
occurrences.kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

occurrences.bsb: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”
occurrences.kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

occurrences.bsb: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
occurrences.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

occurrences.bsb: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.
occurrences.kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

occurrences.bsb: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
occurrences.kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
occurrences.kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

occurrences.bsb: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
occurrences.kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

occurrences.bsb: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
occurrences.kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”
occurrences.kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

occurrences.bsb: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
