occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

occurrences.bsb: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
occurrences.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

occurrences.bsb: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
occurrences.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

occurrences.bsb: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
occurrences.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

occurrences.bsb: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
occurrences.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.

occurrences.bsb: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
occurrences.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

occurrences.bsb: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

occurrences.bsb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
occurrences.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

occurrences.bsb: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
occurrences.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

occurrences.bsb: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”
occurrences.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

occurrences.bsb: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

occurrences.bsb: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
occurrences.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

occurrences.bsb: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
occurrences.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

occurrences.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
occurrences.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

occurrences.bsb: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
occurrences.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

occurrences.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
occurrences.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

occurrences.bsb: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

occurrences.bsb: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

occurrences.bsb: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

occurrences.bsb: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
occurrences.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

occurrences.bsb: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
occurrences.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

occurrences.bsb: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). And at once they were utterly astounded.
occurrences.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

occurrences.bsb: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
occurrences.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

occurrences.bsb: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
occurrences.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

occurrences.bsb: By now the hour was already late. So the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.
occurrences.kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

occurrences.bsb: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.
occurrences.kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

occurrences.bsb: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.
occurrences.kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

occurrences.bsb: He could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,
occurrences.kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

occurrences.bsb: but when they saw Him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking He was a ghost—
occurrences.kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

occurrences.bsb: for they all saw Him and were terrified. But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
occurrences.kjv: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

occurrences.bsb: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened.
occurrences.kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

occurrences.bsb: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.
occurrences.kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

occurrences.bsb: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
occurrences.kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

occurrences.bsb: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
occurrences.kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

occurrences.bsb: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
occurrences.kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

occurrences.bsb: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
occurrences.kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

occurrences.bsb: “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

occurrences.bsb: Now she was a Greek woman of Syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
occurrences.kjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

occurrences.bsb: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

occurrences.bsb: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
occurrences.kjv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

occurrences.bsb: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
occurrences.kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

occurrences.bsb: And about four thousand men were present. And when Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
occurrences.kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

occurrences.bsb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

occurrences.bsb: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
occurrences.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

occurrences.bsb: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
occurrences.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

occurrences.bsb: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

occurrences.bsb: “O unbelieving generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.”
occurrences.kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?” “From childhood,” he said.
occurrences.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

occurrences.bsb: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
occurrences.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied. “For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

occurrences.bsb: For whoever is not against us is for us.
occurrences.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

occurrences.bsb: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

occurrences.bsb: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
occurrences.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
occurrences.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
occurrences.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

occurrences.bsb: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
occurrences.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

occurrences.bsb: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
occurrences.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,

occurrences.bsb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.”
occurrences.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

occurrences.bsb: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
occurrences.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

occurrences.bsb: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
occurrences.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

occurrences.bsb: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
occurrences.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

occurrences.bsb: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

occurrences.bsb: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
occurrences.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
occurrences.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
occurrences.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

occurrences.bsb: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
occurrences.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
occurrences.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

occurrences.bsb: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
occurrences.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

occurrences.bsb: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
occurrences.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”
occurrences.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cesar, or not?

occurrences.bsb: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
occurrences.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

occurrences.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
occurrences.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

occurrences.bsb: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
occurrences.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

occurrences.bsb: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

occurrences.bsb: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.”
occurrences.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

occurrences.bsb: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
occurrences.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

occurrences.bsb: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself. This is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
occurrences.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, He said, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And no one dared to question Him any further.
occurrences.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

occurrences.bsb: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
occurrences.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

occurrences.bsb: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
occurrences.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

occurrences.bsb: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
occurrences.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

occurrences.bsb: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
occurrences.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

occurrences.bsb: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
occurrences.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

occurrences.bsb: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: For those will be days of tribulation unseen from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
occurrences.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

occurrences.bsb: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
occurrences.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

occurrences.bsb: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
occurrences.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

occurrences.bsb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
occurrences.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

occurrences.bsb: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
occurrences.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

occurrences.bsb: Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.
occurrences.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

occurrences.bsb: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
occurrences.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
occurrences.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

occurrences.bsb: Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?
occurrences.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

occurrences.bsb: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
occurrences.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

occurrences.bsb: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take it; this is My body.”
occurrences.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

occurrences.bsb: He said to them, “This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

occurrences.bsb: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

occurrences.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
occurrences.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

occurrences.bsb: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy. And they did not know what to answer Him.
occurrences.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

occurrences.bsb: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.”
occurrences.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

occurrences.bsb: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
occurrences.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire.
occurrences.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

occurrences.bsb: For many bore false witness against Jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
occurrences.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

occurrences.bsb: But even their testimony was inconsistent.
occurrences.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus remained silent and made no reply. Again the high priest questioned Him, “Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?”
occurrences.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

occurrences.bsb: “I am,” said Jesus, “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: While Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the servant girls of the high priest came down
occurrences.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

occurrences.bsb: and saw him warming himself there. She looked at Peter and said, “You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.”
occurrences.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

occurrences.bsb: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, “This man is one of them.”
occurrences.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

occurrences.bsb: But he denied it again. After a little while, those standing nearby said once more to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you too are a Galilean.”
occurrences.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

occurrences.bsb: So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
occurrences.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.

occurrences.bsb: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
occurrences.kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

occurrences.bsb: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
occurrences.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Pretorium; and they call together the whole band.

occurrences.bsb: They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.
occurrences.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

occurrences.bsb: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
occurrences.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

occurrences.bsb: And the charge inscribed against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
occurrences.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

occurrences.bsb: At the ninth hour, Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
occurrences.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

occurrences.bsb: When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how He had breathed His last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
occurrences.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: And there were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.
occurrences.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

occurrences.bsb: These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee, and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with Him.
occurrences.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
occurrences.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

occurrences.bsb: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent Council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of God, boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Joseph of Arimathea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: So Joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of Jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
occurrences.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

occurrences.bsb: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
occurrences.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

occurrences.bsb: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

occurrences.bsb: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

occurrences.bsb: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.
occurrences.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

occurrences.bsb: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
occurrences.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

occurrences.bsb: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

occurrences.bsb: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
occurrences.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

occurrences.bsb: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
occurrences.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

occurrences.bsb: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
occurrences.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

occurrences.bsb: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
occurrences.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

occurrences.bsb: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
occurrences.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

occurrences.bsb: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
occurrences.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

occurrences.bsb: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
occurrences.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

occurrences.bsb: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”
occurrences.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

occurrences.bsb: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

occurrences.bsb: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”
occurrences.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

occurrences.bsb: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
occurrences.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

occurrences.bsb: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
occurrences.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

occurrences.bsb: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.
occurrences.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

occurrences.bsb: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
occurrences.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

occurrences.bsb: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
occurrences.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

occurrences.bsb: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.
occurrences.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

occurrences.bsb: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
occurrences.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

occurrences.bsb: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
occurrences.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

occurrences.bsb: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

occurrences.bsb: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
occurrences.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

occurrences.bsb: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,
occurrences.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

occurrences.bsb: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.
occurrences.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

occurrences.bsb: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
occurrences.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

occurrences.bsb: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.
occurrences.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

occurrences.bsb: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

occurrences.bsb: John answered all of them: “I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
occurrences.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

occurrences.bsb: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
occurrences.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry. He was regarded as the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

occurrences.bsb: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
occurrences.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

occurrences.bsb: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
occurrences.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

occurrences.bsb: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
occurrences.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,
occurrences.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

occurrences.bsb: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
occurrences.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

occurrences.bsb: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,
occurrences.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

occurrences.bsb: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.
occurrences.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?

occurrences.bsb: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
occurrences.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

occurrences.bsb: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
occurrences.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

occurrences.bsb: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.
occurrences.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

occurrences.bsb: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.
occurrences.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

occurrences.bsb: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
occurrences.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

occurrences.bsb: “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

occurrences.bsb: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf,
occurrences.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

occurrences.bsb: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
occurrences.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

occurrences.bsb: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

occurrences.bsb: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon and asked him to put out a little from shore. And sitting down, He taught the people from the boat.
occurrences.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

occurrences.bsb: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
occurrences.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

occurrences.bsb: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee. “Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”
occurrences.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

occurrences.bsb: Yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray.
occurrences.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

occurrences.bsb: One day Jesus was teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. People had come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea, and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal the sick.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

occurrences.bsb: Just then some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him inside to set him before Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

occurrences.bsb: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
occurrences.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

occurrences.bsb: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
occurrences.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

occurrences.bsb: Then Levi hosted a great banquet for Jesus at his house. A large crowd of tax collectors was there, along with others who were eating with them.
occurrences.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

occurrences.bsb: And no one after drinking old wine wants new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
occurrences.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

occurrences.bsb: On another Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was withered.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

occurrences.bsb: In those days Jesus went out to the mountain to pray, and He spent the night in prayer to God.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

occurrences.bsb: Looking up at His disciples, Jesus said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
occurrences.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.

occurrences.bsb: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
occurrences.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

occurrences.bsb: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do the same.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

occurrences.bsb: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

occurrences.bsb: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
occurrences.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

occurrences.bsb: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
occurrences.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

occurrences.bsb: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
occurrences.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

occurrences.bsb: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
occurrences.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

occurrences.bsb: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

occurrences.bsb: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid his foundation on the rock. When the flood came, the torrent crashed against that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
occurrences.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who hears My words and does not act on them is like a man who built his house on ground without a foundation. The torrent crashed against that house, and immediately it fell—and great was its destruction!”
occurrences.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

occurrences.bsb: There a highly valued servant of a centurion was sick and about to die.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

occurrences.bsb: They came to Jesus and pleaded with Him earnestly, “This man is worthy to have You grant this,
occurrences.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus went with them. But when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends with the message: “Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

occurrences.bsb: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
occurrences.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

occurrences.bsb: As He approached the town gate, He saw a dead man being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
occurrences.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

occurrences.bsb: So John called two of his disciples and sent them to ask the Lord, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
occurrences.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

occurrences.bsb: When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?’”
occurrences.kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

occurrences.bsb: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in palaces.
occurrences.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

occurrences.bsb: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
occurrences.kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John, yet even the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.”
occurrences.kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

occurrences.bsb: “To what, then, can I compare the men of this generation? What are they like?
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

occurrences.bsb: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
occurrences.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

occurrences.bsb: When a sinful woman from that town learned that Jesus was dining there, she brought an alabaster jar of perfume.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

occurrences.bsb: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!”
occurrences.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: “Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
occurrences.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

occurrences.bsb: But those at the table began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
occurrences.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

occurrences.bsb: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
occurrences.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

occurrences.bsb: Then His disciples asked Him what this parable meant.
occurrences.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

occurrences.bsb: Now this is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
occurrences.kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

occurrences.bsb: The seeds along the path are those who hear, but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
occurrences.kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

occurrences.bsb: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and their fruit does not mature.
occurrences.kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

occurrences.bsb: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop.
occurrences.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

occurrences.bsb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
occurrences.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

occurrences.bsb: But He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.”
occurrences.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is your faith?” He asked. Frightened and amazed, they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

occurrences.bsb: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
occurrences.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

occurrences.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

occurrences.bsb: There on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding. So the demons begged Jesus to let them enter the pigs, and He gave them permission.
occurrences.kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

occurrences.bsb: because his only daughter, who was about twelve, was dying. As Jesus went with him, the crowds pressed around Him,
occurrences.kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

occurrences.bsb: including a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
occurrences.kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

occurrences.bsb: “I beheaded John,” Herod said, “but who is this man I hear such things about?” And he kept trying to see Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

occurrences.bsb: As the day neared its end, the Twelve came to Jesus and said, “Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

occurrences.bsb: (There were about five thousand men.) He told His disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
occurrences.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you truly, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”
occurrences.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

occurrences.bsb: As Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” (He did not know what he was saying.)
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

occurrences.bsb: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!”
occurrences.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

occurrences.bsb: Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

occurrences.bsb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

occurrences.bsb: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
occurrences.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

occurrences.bsb: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
occurrences.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

occurrences.bsb: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

occurrences.bsb: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
occurrences.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

occurrences.bsb: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
occurrences.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”
occurrences.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

occurrences.bsb: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.
occurrences.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.

occurrences.bsb: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”
occurrences.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

occurrences.bsb: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
occurrences.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

occurrences.bsb: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
occurrences.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

occurrences.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
occurrences.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

occurrences.bsb: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
occurrences.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

occurrences.bsb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
occurrences.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
