occurrences.bsb: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
occurrences.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
occurrences.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

occurrences.bsb: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
occurrences.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

occurrences.bsb: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

occurrences.bsb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
occurrences.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean for you.
occurrences.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

occurrences.bsb: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
occurrences.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

occurrences.bsb: In the meantime, a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling one another. Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
occurrences.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

occurrences.bsb: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
occurrences.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

occurrences.bsb: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
occurrences.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

occurrences.bsb: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

occurrences.bsb: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’
occurrences.kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

occurrences.bsb: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
occurrences.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

occurrences.bsb: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
occurrences.kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

occurrences.bsb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
occurrences.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

occurrences.bsb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
occurrences.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

occurrences.bsb: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
occurrences.kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

occurrences.bsb: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
occurrences.kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

occurrences.bsb: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
occurrences.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

occurrences.bsb: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
occurrences.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

occurrences.bsb: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
occurrences.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

occurrences.bsb: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

occurrences.bsb: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath. “There are six days for work,” he told the crowd. “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.”
occurrences.kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

occurrences.bsb: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?”
occurrences.kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
occurrences.kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

occurrences.bsb: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.”
occurrences.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

occurrences.bsb: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
occurrences.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

occurrences.bsb: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
occurrences.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

occurrences.bsb: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’
occurrences.kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
occurrences.kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

occurrences.bsb: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

occurrences.bsb: One Sabbath, Jesus went to eat in the home of a leading Pharisee, and those in attendance were watching Him closely.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

occurrences.bsb: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

occurrences.bsb: “When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
occurrences.kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

occurrences.bsb: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
occurrences.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

occurrences.bsb: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

occurrences.bsb: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
occurrences.kjv: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
occurrences.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

occurrences.bsb: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
occurrences.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

occurrences.bsb: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
occurrences.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

occurrences.bsb: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
occurrences.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you that in the same way there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
occurrences.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

occurrences.bsb: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
occurrences.kjv: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

occurrences.bsb: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
occurrences.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

occurrences.bsb: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
occurrences.kjv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
occurrences.kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

occurrences.bsb: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
occurrences.kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

occurrences.bsb: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”
occurrences.kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
occurrences.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

occurrences.bsb: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
occurrences.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
occurrences.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

occurrences.bsb: So He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

occurrences.bsb: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
occurrences.kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

occurrences.bsb: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
occurrences.kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
occurrences.kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

occurrences.bsb: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’”
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

occurrences.bsb: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
occurrences.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

occurrences.bsb: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

occurrences.bsb: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
occurrences.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

occurrences.bsb: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
occurrences.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

occurrences.bsb: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
occurrences.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

occurrences.bsb: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
occurrences.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
occurrences.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

occurrences.bsb: Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.”
occurrences.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

occurrences.bsb: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

occurrences.bsb: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
occurrences.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

occurrences.bsb: To some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, He also told this parable:
occurrences.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

occurrences.bsb: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
occurrences.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus called the children to Him and said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
occurrences.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
occurrences.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

occurrences.bsb: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. The meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what He was saying.
occurrences.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

occurrences.bsb: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
occurrences.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

occurrences.bsb: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zaccheus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

occurrences.bsb: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
occurrences.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

occurrences.bsb: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
occurrences.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

occurrences.bsb: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

occurrences.bsb: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
occurrences.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.
occurrences.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

occurrences.bsb: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
occurrences.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

occurrences.bsb: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?”
occurrences.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
occurrences.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
occurrences.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
occurrences.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife but died childless.
occurrences.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

occurrences.bsb: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
occurrences.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

occurrences.bsb: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
occurrences.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
occurrences.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
occurrences.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

occurrences.bsb: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.

occurrences.bsb: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
occurrences.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
occurrences.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

occurrences.bsb: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

occurrences.bsb: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
occurrences.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

occurrences.bsb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

occurrences.bsb: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
occurrences.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

occurrences.bsb: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
occurrences.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

occurrences.bsb: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

occurrences.bsb: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

occurrences.bsb: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
occurrences.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

occurrences.bsb: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
occurrences.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

occurrences.bsb: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

occurrences.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

occurrences.bsb: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

occurrences.bsb: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
occurrences.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

occurrences.bsb: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”
occurrences.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

occurrences.bsb: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.
occurrences.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

occurrences.bsb: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
occurrences.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

occurrences.bsb: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
occurrences.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilean.

occurrences.bsb: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
occurrences.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

occurrences.bsb: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
occurrences.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

occurrences.bsb: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

occurrences.bsb: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
occurrences.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

occurrences.bsb: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
occurrences.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilean.

occurrences.bsb: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
occurrences.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

occurrences.bsb: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
occurrences.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

occurrences.bsb: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
occurrences.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

occurrences.bsb: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
occurrences.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

occurrences.bsb: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
occurrences.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

occurrences.bsb: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
occurrences.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

occurrences.bsb: Above Him was posted an inscription: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
occurrences.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

occurrences.bsb: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “Are You not the Christ?” he said. “Save Yourself and us!”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

occurrences.bsb: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
occurrences.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

occurrences.bsb: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

occurrences.bsb: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
occurrences.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

occurrences.bsb: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”
occurrences.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

occurrences.bsb: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
occurrences.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
occurrences.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

occurrences.bsb: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
occurrences.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

occurrences.bsb: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
occurrences.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

occurrences.bsb: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
occurrences.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

occurrences.bsb: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
occurrences.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

occurrences.bsb: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

occurrences.bsb: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
occurrences.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

occurrences.bsb: But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.” So He went in to stay with them.
occurrences.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

occurrences.bsb: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
occurrences.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

occurrences.bsb: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

occurrences.bsb: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
occurrences.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

occurrences.bsb: You are witnesses of these things.
occurrences.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.

occurrences.bsb: praising God continually in the temple.
occurrences.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
occurrences.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

occurrences.bsb: He was with God in the beginning.
occurrences.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.

occurrences.bsb: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
occurrences.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

occurrences.bsb: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
occurrences.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

occurrences.bsb: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
occurrences.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

occurrences.bsb: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
occurrences.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

occurrences.bsb: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
occurrences.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

occurrences.bsb: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
occurrences.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

occurrences.bsb: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
occurrences.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

occurrences.bsb: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
occurrences.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

occurrences.bsb: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
occurrences.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

occurrences.bsb: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

occurrences.bsb: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
occurrences.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

occurrences.bsb: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
occurrences.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

occurrences.bsb: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
occurrences.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

occurrences.bsb: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
occurrences.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

occurrences.bsb: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
occurrences.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

occurrences.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
occurrences.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
occurrences.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

occurrences.bsb: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

occurrences.bsb: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
occurrences.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
occurrences.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

occurrences.bsb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
occurrences.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

occurrences.bsb: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
occurrences.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

occurrences.bsb: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
occurrences.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
occurrences.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

occurrences.bsb: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
occurrences.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

occurrences.bsb: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
occurrences.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

occurrences.bsb: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

occurrences.bsb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

occurrences.bsb: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
occurrences.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

occurrences.bsb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
occurrences.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

occurrences.bsb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
occurrences.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

occurrences.bsb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
occurrences.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

occurrences.bsb: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
occurrences.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

occurrences.bsb: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

occurrences.bsb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

occurrences.bsb: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

occurrences.bsb: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
occurrences.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

occurrences.bsb: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
occurrences.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

occurrences.bsb: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
occurrences.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

occurrences.bsb: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

occurrences.bsb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
occurrences.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
occurrences.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

occurrences.bsb: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
occurrences.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

occurrences.bsb: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
occurrences.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

occurrences.bsb: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
occurrences.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

occurrences.bsb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
occurrences.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

occurrences.bsb: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
occurrences.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
occurrences.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

occurrences.bsb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
occurrences.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

occurrences.bsb: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
occurrences.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

occurrences.bsb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
occurrences.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
occurrences.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

occurrences.bsb: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
occurrences.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

occurrences.bsb: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

occurrences.bsb: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
occurrences.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

occurrences.bsb: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
occurrences.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

occurrences.bsb: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

occurrences.bsb: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
occurrences.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

occurrences.bsb: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

occurrences.bsb: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
occurrences.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

occurrences.bsb: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
occurrences.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

occurrences.bsb: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
occurrences.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

occurrences.bsb: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

occurrences.bsb: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

occurrences.bsb: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
occurrences.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

occurrences.bsb: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
occurrences.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

occurrences.bsb: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
occurrences.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

occurrences.bsb: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
occurrences.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

occurrences.bsb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
occurrences.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

occurrences.bsb: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
occurrences.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

occurrences.bsb: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
occurrences.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

occurrences.bsb: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

occurrences.bsb: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
occurrences.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
occurrences.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

occurrences.bsb: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
occurrences.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

occurrences.bsb: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
occurrences.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

occurrences.bsb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
occurrences.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

occurrences.bsb: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
occurrences.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
occurrences.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

occurrences.bsb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
occurrences.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

occurrences.bsb: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
occurrences.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

occurrences.bsb: I am the bread of life.
occurrences.kjv: I am that bread of life.

occurrences.bsb: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
occurrences.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

occurrences.bsb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

occurrences.bsb: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
occurrences.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

occurrences.bsb: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
occurrences.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
occurrences.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

occurrences.bsb: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
occurrences.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

occurrences.bsb: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
occurrences.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

occurrences.bsb: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
occurrences.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

occurrences.bsb: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

occurrences.bsb: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

occurrences.bsb: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
occurrences.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

occurrences.bsb: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”
occurrences.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

occurrences.bsb: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.” But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
occurrences.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

occurrences.bsb: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
occurrences.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

occurrences.bsb: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
occurrences.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

occurrences.bsb: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
occurrences.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

occurrences.bsb: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
occurrences.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

occurrences.bsb: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
occurrences.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

occurrences.bsb: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
occurrences.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

occurrences.bsb: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”
occurrences.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
occurrences.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

occurrences.bsb: What does He mean by saying, ‘You will look for Me, but you will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
occurrences.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

occurrences.bsb: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
occurrences.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

occurrences.bsb: On hearing these words, some of the people said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
occurrences.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Others declared, “This is the Christ.” But still others asked, “How can the Christ come from Galilee?
occurrences.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

occurrences.bsb: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?”
occurrences.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

occurrences.bsb: But this crowd that does not know the law—they are under a curse.”
occurrences.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

occurrences.bsb: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them, asked,
occurrences.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

occurrences.bsb: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
occurrences.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
occurrences.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

occurrences.bsb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
occurrences.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

occurrences.bsb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
occurrences.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

occurrences.bsb: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”
occurrences.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

occurrences.bsb: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
occurrences.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

occurrences.bsb: “Who are You?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
occurrences.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

occurrences.bsb: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

occurrences.bsb: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

occurrences.bsb: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
occurrences.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

occurrences.bsb: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
occurrences.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

occurrences.bsb: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
occurrences.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
