occurrences.bsb: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

occurrences.bsb: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
occurrences.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

occurrences.bsb: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
occurrences.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

occurrences.bsb: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
occurrences.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

occurrences.bsb: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
occurrences.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

occurrences.bsb: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
occurrences.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

occurrences.bsb: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
occurrences.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

occurrences.bsb: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
occurrences.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

occurrences.bsb: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
occurrences.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered.
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

occurrences.bsb: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
occurrences.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

occurrences.bsb: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

occurrences.bsb: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
occurrences.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
occurrences.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

occurrences.bsb: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
occurrences.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

occurrences.bsb: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
occurrences.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

occurrences.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
occurrences.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

occurrences.bsb: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
occurrences.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

occurrences.bsb: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
occurrences.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

occurrences.bsb: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
occurrences.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

occurrences.bsb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
occurrences.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

occurrences.bsb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
occurrences.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

occurrences.bsb: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

occurrences.bsb: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

occurrences.bsb: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and they asked Him, “Are we blind too?”
occurrences.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

occurrences.bsb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
occurrences.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
occurrences.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

occurrences.bsb: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

occurrences.bsb: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
occurrences.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

occurrences.bsb: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
occurrences.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

occurrences.bsb: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
occurrences.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

occurrences.bsb: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

occurrences.bsb: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.
occurrences.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

occurrences.bsb: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
occurrences.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

occurrences.bsb: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
occurrences.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

occurrences.bsb: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
occurrences.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

occurrences.bsb: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
occurrences.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

occurrences.bsb: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
occurrences.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

occurrences.bsb: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
occurrences.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

occurrences.bsb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
occurrences.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

occurrences.bsb: I and the Father are one.”
occurrences.kjv: I and my Father are one.

occurrences.bsb: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

occurrences.bsb: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
occurrences.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
occurrences.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

occurrences.bsb: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
occurrences.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

occurrences.bsb: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
occurrences.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

occurrences.bsb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
occurrences.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

occurrences.bsb: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
occurrences.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
occurrences.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

occurrences.bsb: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
occurrences.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,
occurrences.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

occurrences.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

occurrences.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
occurrences.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

occurrences.bsb: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

occurrences.bsb: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
occurrences.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

occurrences.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
occurrences.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

occurrences.bsb: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

occurrences.bsb: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
occurrences.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

occurrences.bsb: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
occurrences.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

occurrences.bsb: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
occurrences.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

occurrences.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

occurrences.bsb: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
occurrences.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

occurrences.bsb: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
occurrences.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

occurrences.bsb: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
occurrences.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, many people who had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify.
occurrences.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
occurrences.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

occurrences.bsb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
occurrences.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

occurrences.bsb: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
occurrences.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

occurrences.bsb: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
occurrences.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

occurrences.bsb: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
occurrences.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

occurrences.bsb: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
occurrences.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

occurrences.bsb: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
occurrences.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

occurrences.bsb: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
occurrences.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

occurrences.bsb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

occurrences.bsb: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
occurrences.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

occurrences.bsb: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
occurrences.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

occurrences.bsb: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
occurrences.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

occurrences.bsb: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
occurrences.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

occurrences.bsb: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
occurrences.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

occurrences.bsb: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
occurrences.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

occurrences.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
occurrences.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

occurrences.bsb: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
occurrences.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

occurrences.bsb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
occurrences.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

occurrences.bsb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
occurrences.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

occurrences.bsb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
occurrences.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

occurrences.bsb: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
occurrences.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
occurrences.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

occurrences.bsb: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
occurrences.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

occurrences.bsb: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
occurrences.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

occurrences.bsb: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
occurrences.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

occurrences.bsb: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
occurrences.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

occurrences.bsb: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
occurrences.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

occurrences.bsb: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
occurrences.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

occurrences.bsb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

occurrences.bsb: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
occurrences.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

occurrences.bsb: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
occurrences.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

occurrences.bsb: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
occurrences.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
occurrences.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

occurrences.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
occurrences.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

occurrences.bsb: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”
occurrences.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

occurrences.bsb: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
occurrences.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

occurrences.bsb: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

occurrences.bsb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
occurrences.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

occurrences.bsb: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
occurrences.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

occurrences.bsb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
occurrences.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

occurrences.bsb: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
occurrences.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

occurrences.bsb: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
occurrences.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

occurrences.bsb: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
occurrences.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

occurrences.bsb: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
occurrences.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

occurrences.bsb: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
occurrences.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

occurrences.bsb: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
occurrences.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

occurrences.bsb: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
occurrences.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

occurrences.bsb: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

occurrences.bsb: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
occurrences.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

occurrences.bsb: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
occurrences.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

occurrences.bsb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
occurrences.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

occurrences.bsb: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

occurrences.bsb: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
occurrences.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
occurrences.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

occurrences.bsb: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

occurrences.bsb: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
occurrences.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

occurrences.bsb: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
occurrences.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

occurrences.bsb: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
occurrences.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

occurrences.bsb: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
occurrences.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

occurrences.bsb: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
occurrences.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.

occurrences.bsb: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
occurrences.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
occurrences.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

occurrences.bsb: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
occurrences.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

occurrences.bsb: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
occurrences.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

occurrences.bsb: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
occurrences.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

occurrences.bsb: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
occurrences.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

occurrences.bsb: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
occurrences.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

occurrences.bsb: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
occurrences.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

occurrences.bsb: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
occurrences.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

occurrences.bsb: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
occurrences.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

occurrences.bsb: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
occurrences.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

occurrences.bsb: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
occurrences.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

occurrences.bsb: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
occurrences.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
occurrences.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

occurrences.bsb: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
occurrences.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

occurrences.bsb: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
occurrences.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

occurrences.bsb: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
occurrences.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

occurrences.bsb: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
occurrences.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

occurrences.bsb: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
occurrences.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

occurrences.bsb: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
occurrences.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

occurrences.bsb: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
occurrences.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

occurrences.bsb: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.
occurrences.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
occurrences.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

occurrences.bsb: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
occurrences.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

occurrences.bsb: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
occurrences.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

occurrences.bsb: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
occurrences.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

occurrences.bsb: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
occurrences.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

occurrences.bsb: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

occurrences.bsb: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
occurrences.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
occurrences.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

occurrences.bsb: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
occurrences.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
occurrences.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

occurrences.bsb: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
occurrences.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
occurrences.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

occurrences.bsb: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

occurrences.bsb: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
occurrences.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

occurrences.bsb: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
occurrences.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

occurrences.bsb: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

occurrences.bsb: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

occurrences.bsb: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
occurrences.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

occurrences.bsb: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
occurrences.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

occurrences.bsb: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
occurrences.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

occurrences.bsb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
occurrences.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.

occurrences.bsb: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
occurrences.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

occurrences.bsb: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
occurrences.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

occurrences.bsb: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,
occurrences.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

occurrences.bsb: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
occurrences.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

occurrences.bsb: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
occurrences.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

occurrences.bsb: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
occurrences.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

occurrences.bsb: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
occurrences.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

occurrences.bsb: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
occurrences.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
occurrences.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galileans?

occurrences.bsb: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”
occurrences.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

occurrences.bsb: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

occurrences.bsb: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
occurrences.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

occurrences.bsb: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
occurrences.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

occurrences.bsb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip.
occurrences.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

occurrences.bsb: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
occurrences.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
occurrences.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

occurrences.bsb: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
occurrences.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
occurrences.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

occurrences.bsb: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
occurrences.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

occurrences.bsb: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
occurrences.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

occurrences.bsb: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
occurrences.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

occurrences.bsb: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of this fact.
occurrences.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.’
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

occurrences.bsb: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

occurrences.bsb: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.
occurrences.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

occurrences.bsb: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.
occurrences.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
occurrences.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

occurrences.bsb: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
occurrences.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

occurrences.bsb: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

occurrences.bsb: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

occurrences.bsb: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
occurrences.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

occurrences.bsb: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

occurrences.bsb: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.
occurrences.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

occurrences.bsb: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
occurrences.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

occurrences.bsb: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,
occurrences.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

occurrences.bsb: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
occurrences.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

occurrences.bsb: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
occurrences.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

occurrences.bsb: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
occurrences.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

occurrences.bsb: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”
occurrences.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

occurrences.bsb: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

occurrences.bsb: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
occurrences.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

occurrences.bsb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
occurrences.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

occurrences.bsb: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
occurrences.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

occurrences.bsb: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

occurrences.bsb: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
occurrences.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

occurrences.bsb: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
occurrences.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

occurrences.bsb: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
occurrences.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

occurrences.bsb: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
occurrences.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

occurrences.bsb: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
occurrences.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:

occurrences.bsb: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
occurrences.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

occurrences.bsb: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
occurrences.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

occurrences.bsb: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
occurrences.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

occurrences.bsb: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
occurrences.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

occurrences.bsb: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.
occurrences.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

occurrences.bsb: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
occurrences.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

occurrences.bsb: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
occurrences.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.

occurrences.bsb: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”
occurrences.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

occurrences.bsb: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.
occurrences.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

occurrences.bsb: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

occurrences.bsb: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
occurrences.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

occurrences.bsb: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

occurrences.bsb: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
occurrences.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

occurrences.bsb: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
occurrences.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

occurrences.bsb: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.
occurrences.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
occurrences.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

occurrences.bsb: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

occurrences.bsb: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
occurrences.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

occurrences.bsb: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
occurrences.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

occurrences.bsb: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
occurrences.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

occurrences.bsb: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
occurrences.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

occurrences.bsb: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

occurrences.bsb: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
occurrences.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

occurrences.bsb: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
