occurrences.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Eneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

occurrences.bsb: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
occurrences.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

occurrences.bsb: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”
occurrences.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

occurrences.bsb: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

occurrences.bsb: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
occurrences.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

occurrences.bsb: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
occurrences.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

occurrences.bsb: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
occurrences.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,

occurrences.bsb: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

occurrences.bsb: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
occurrences.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
occurrences.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

occurrences.bsb: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

occurrences.bsb: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
occurrences.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

occurrences.bsb: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

occurrences.bsb: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
occurrences.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

occurrences.bsb: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
occurrences.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

occurrences.bsb: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
occurrences.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

occurrences.bsb: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
occurrences.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

occurrences.bsb: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
occurrences.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

occurrences.bsb: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
occurrences.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

occurrences.bsb: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cesarea unto me.

occurrences.bsb: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

occurrences.bsb: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
occurrences.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

occurrences.bsb: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)
occurrences.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
occurrences.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

occurrences.bsb: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
occurrences.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

occurrences.bsb: On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.
occurrences.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

occurrences.bsb: So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.
occurrences.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

occurrences.bsb: And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.

occurrences.bsb: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”

occurrences.bsb: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

occurrences.bsb: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.

occurrences.bsb: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

occurrences.bsb: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.

occurrences.bsb: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
occurrences.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.

occurrences.bsb: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

occurrences.bsb: where they continued to preach the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

occurrences.bsb: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.

occurrences.bsb: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the brothers.

occurrences.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

occurrences.bsb: During the night, Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and pleading with him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”

occurrences.bsb: From there we went to the Roman colony of Philippi, the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
occurrences.kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

occurrences.bsb: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!”

occurrences.bsb: by promoting customs that are unlawful for us Romans to adopt or practice.”

occurrences.bsb: explaining and proving that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. “This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Christ,” he declared.

occurrences.bsb: Now the Bereans were more noble-minded than the Thessalonians, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true.
occurrences.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

occurrences.bsb: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was deeply disturbed in his spirit to see that the city was full of idols.
occurrences.kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

occurrences.bsb: ‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’

occurrences.bsb: and he stayed and worked with them because they were tentmakers by trade, just as he was.

occurrences.bsb: For I am with you and no one will lay a hand on you, because I have many people in this city.”
occurrences.kjv: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

occurrences.bsb: But just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio told the Jews, “If this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to hear your complaint.
occurrences.kjv: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

occurrences.bsb: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.”
occurrences.kjv: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

occurrences.bsb: There were about twelve men in all.

occurrences.kjv: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

occurrences.bsb: Since these things are undeniable, you ought to be calm and not do anything rash.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.

occurrences.bsb: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have ministered to my own needs and those of my companions.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

occurrences.bsb: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
occurrences.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

occurrences.bsb: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

occurrences.bsb: When they heard this, they glorified God. Then they said to Paul, “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
occurrences.kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

occurrences.bsb: Take these men, purify yourself along with them, and pay their expenses so they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know that there is no truth to these rumors about you, but that you also live in obedience to the law.
occurrences.kjv: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

occurrences.bsb: crying out, “Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and against our law and against this place. Furthermore, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”

occurrences.bsb: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
occurrences.kjv: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

occurrences.bsb: The commander came up and arrested Paul, ordering that he be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.
occurrences.kjv: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

occurrences.bsb: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the Assassins into the wilderness?”

occurrences.bsb: But Paul answered, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Now I beg you to allow me to speak to the people.”
occurrences.kjv: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

occurrences.bsb: as the high priest and the whole Council can testify about me. I even obtained letters from them to their brothers in Damascus, and I was on my way to apprehend these people and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
occurrences.kjv: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ He replied.

occurrences.bsb: My companions saw the light, but they could not understand the voice of the One speaking to me.

occurrences.bsb: You will be His witness to everyone of what you have seen and heard.

occurrences.bsb: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
occurrences.kjv: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing this, the centurion went and reported it to the commander. “What are you going to do?” he said. “This man is a Roman citizen.”
occurrences.kjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

occurrences.bsb: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes,” he answered.
occurrences.kjv: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

occurrences.bsb: At once those who were about to interrogate Paul stepped back, and the commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains.
occurrences.kjv: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

occurrences.kjv: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.”

occurrences.bsb: More than forty of them were involved in this plot.
occurrences.kjv: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

occurrences.bsb: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.”
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

occurrences.bsb: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside, and asked, “What do you need to tell me?”
occurrences.kjv: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?

occurrences.bsb: Do not let them persuade you, because more than forty men are waiting to ambush him. They have bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him; they are ready now, awaiting your consent.”
occurrences.kjv: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

occurrences.bsb: This man was seized by the Jews, and they were about to kill him when I came with my troops to rescue him. For I had learned that he is a Roman citizen,
occurrences.kjv: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

occurrences.bsb: When I was informed that there was a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also instructed his accusers to present their case against him before you.
occurrences.kjv: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

occurrences.bsb: The governor read the letter and asked what province Paul was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,
occurrences.kjv: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;

occurrences.bsb: When the governor motioned for Paul to speak, he began his response: “Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, I gladly make my defense.
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:

occurrences.bsb: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
occurrences.kjv: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

occurrences.bsb: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

occurrences.bsb: Paul replied, “I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Paul, I stand at Cesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

occurrences.bsb: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
occurrences.kjv: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: Since they were staying several days, Festus laid out Paul’s case before the king: “There is a certain man whom Felix left in prison.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul’s cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

occurrences.bsb: I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand a man over before he has had an opportunity to face his accusers and defend himself against their charges.
occurrences.kjv: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

occurrences.bsb: especially since you are acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. I beg you, therefore, to listen to me patiently.
occurrences.kjv: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
occurrences.kjv: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

occurrences.bsb: For the king knows about these matters, and I can speak freely to him. I am confident that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.
occurrences.kjv: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.

occurrences.bsb: “Short time or long,” Paul replied, “I wish to God that not only you but all who hear me this day may become what I am, except for these chains.”
occurrences.kjv: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

occurrences.bsb: We boarded an Adramyttian ship about to sail for ports along the coast of Asia, and we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.
occurrences.kjv: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

occurrences.bsb: After we had moved along the coast with difficulty, we came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.
occurrences.kjv: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

occurrences.bsb: By now much time had passed, and the voyage had already become dangerous because it was after the Fast. So Paul advised them,
occurrences.kjv: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

occurrences.bsb: “Men, I can see that our voyage will be filled with disaster and great loss, not only to ship and cargo, but to our own lives as well.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

occurrences.bsb: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because you will not experience any loss of life, but only of the ship.
occurrences.kjv: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man’s life among you, but of the ship.

occurrences.bsb: For just last night an angel of the God to whom I belong and whom I serve stood beside me
occurrences.kjv: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

occurrences.bsb: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

occurrences.bsb: In all, there were 276 of us on board.
occurrences.kjv: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

occurrences.bsb: When the islanders saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “Surely this man is a murderer. Although he was saved from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

occurrences.bsb: After three days, he called together the leaders of the Jews. When they had gathered, he said to them, “Brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or the customs of our fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

occurrences.bsb: But we consider your views worth hearing, because we know that people everywhere are speaking against this sect.”
occurrences.kjv: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

occurrences.bsb: They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul had made this final statement: “The Holy Spirit was right when He spoke to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet:
occurrences.kjv: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,

occurrences.bsb: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”
occurrences.kjv: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

occurrences.bsb: And you also are among those who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: God, whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you
occurrences.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

occurrences.bsb: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.
occurrences.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

occurrences.bsb: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.
occurrences.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

occurrences.bsb: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
occurrences.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

occurrences.bsb: For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
occurrences.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

occurrences.bsb: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
occurrences.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

occurrences.bsb: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.
occurrences.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

occurrences.bsb: For God does not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
occurrences.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

occurrences.bsb: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
occurrences.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

occurrences.bsb: A man is not a Jew because he is one outwardly, nor is circumcision only outward and physical.
occurrences.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

occurrences.bsb: Why not say, as some slanderously claim that we say, “Let us do evil that good may result”? Their condemnation is deserved!
occurrences.kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

occurrences.bsb: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
occurrences.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

occurrences.bsb: There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
occurrences.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

occurrences.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
occurrences.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

occurrences.bsb: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
occurrences.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

occurrences.bsb: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,
occurrences.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

occurrences.bsb: In what context was it credited? Was it after his circumcision, or before? It was not after, but before.
occurrences.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

occurrences.bsb: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law, there is no transgression.
occurrences.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

occurrences.bsb: As it is written: “I have made you a father of many nations.” He is our father in the presence of God, in whom he believed, the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being what does not yet exist.
occurrences.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

occurrences.bsb: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as he had been told, “So shall your offspring be.”
occurrences.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

occurrences.bsb: being fully persuaded that God was able to do what He had promised.
occurrences.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

occurrences.bsb: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
occurrences.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

occurrences.bsb: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
occurrences.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

occurrences.bsb: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
occurrences.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

occurrences.bsb: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
occurrences.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

occurrences.bsb: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
occurrences.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

occurrences.bsb: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
occurrences.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

occurrences.bsb: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!
occurrences.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.
occurrences.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

occurrences.bsb: For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.
occurrences.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

occurrences.bsb: For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.
occurrences.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

occurrences.bsb: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
occurrences.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

occurrences.bsb: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.
occurrences.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

occurrences.bsb: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
occurrences.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

occurrences.bsb: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.
occurrences.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

occurrences.bsb: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
occurrences.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

occurrences.bsb: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
occurrences.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

occurrences.bsb: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
occurrences.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

occurrences.bsb: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

occurrences.bsb: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
occurrences.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

occurrences.bsb: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
occurrences.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

occurrences.bsb: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
occurrences.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

occurrences.bsb: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children. On the contrary, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

occurrences.bsb: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.
occurrences.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

occurrences.bsb: For this is what the promise stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
occurrences.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

occurrences.bsb: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
occurrences.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

occurrences.bsb: and, “It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’”
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

occurrences.bsb: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

occurrences.bsb: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
occurrences.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

occurrences.bsb: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”
occurrences.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

occurrences.bsb: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
occurrences.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

occurrences.bsb: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
occurrences.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

occurrences.bsb: I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
occurrences.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

occurrences.bsb: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
occurrences.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

occurrences.bsb: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
occurrences.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

occurrences.bsb: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
occurrences.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: A hardening in part has come to Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
occurrences.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

occurrences.bsb: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
occurrences.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

occurrences.bsb: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
occurrences.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
occurrences.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

occurrences.bsb: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
occurrences.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

occurrences.bsb: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
occurrences.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

occurrences.bsb: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
occurrences.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

occurrences.bsb: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
occurrences.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

occurrences.bsb: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.

occurrences.bsb: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
occurrences.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

occurrences.bsb: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

occurrences.bsb: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct one another.
occurrences.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

occurrences.bsb: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
occurrences.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

occurrences.bsb: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.
occurrences.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

occurrences.bsb: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
occurrences.kjv: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

occurrences.bsb: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.
occurrences.kjv: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

occurrences.bsb: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”
occurrences.kjv: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
occurrences.kjv: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

occurrences.bsb: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength.
occurrences.kjv: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

occurrences.bsb: He chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,
occurrences.kjv: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

occurrences.bsb: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
occurrences.kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

occurrences.bsb: so that your faith would not rest on men’s wisdom, but on God’s power.
occurrences.kjv: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

occurrences.bsb: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God. For they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
occurrences.kjv: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

occurrences.bsb: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
occurrences.kjv: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

occurrences.bsb: For when one of you says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” are you not mere men?
occurrences.kjv: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

occurrences.bsb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
occurrences.kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

occurrences.bsb: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
occurrences.kjv: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

occurrences.bsb: He who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
occurrences.kjv: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

occurrences.bsb: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.
occurrences.kjv: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.

occurrences.bsb: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: his workmanship will be evident, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will prove the quality of each man’s work.
occurrences.kjv: Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that you yourselves are God’s temple, and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

occurrences.bsb: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
occurrences.kjv: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.

occurrences.bsb: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
occurrences.kjv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.

occurrences.bsb: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, stop boasting in men. All things are yours,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;

occurrences.bsb: I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
occurrences.kjv: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man’s judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.

occurrences.bsb: My conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. It is the Lord who judges me.
occurrences.kjv: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Already you have all you want. Already you have become rich. Without us, you have become kings. How I wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
occurrences.kjv: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

occurrences.bsb: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?
occurrences.kjv: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.

occurrences.bsb: Get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
occurrences.kjv: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:

occurrences.bsb: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.
occurrences.kjv: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
occurrences.kjv: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

occurrences.bsb: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?

occurrences.bsb: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
occurrences.kjv: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

occurrences.bsb: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
occurrences.kjv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;
occurrences.kjv: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?

occurrences.bsb: Do not deprive each other, except by mutual consent and for a time, so you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again, so that Satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control.
occurrences.kjv: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

occurrences.bsb: But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
occurrences.kjv: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.

occurrences.bsb: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
occurrences.kjv: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

occurrences.bsb: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commandments is what counts.
occurrences.kjv: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

occurrences.bsb: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman. Conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave.
occurrences.kjv: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
occurrences.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

occurrences.bsb: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
occurrences.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

occurrences.bsb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
occurrences.kjv: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

occurrences.bsb: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

occurrences.bsb: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
occurrences.kjv: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

occurrences.bsb: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?
occurrences.kjv: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?

occurrences.bsb: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: This is my defense to those who scrutinize me:
occurrences.kjv: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,

occurrences.bsb: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
occurrences.kjv: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

occurrences.bsb: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it.
occurrences.kjv: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
occurrences.kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

occurrences.bsb: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), to win those under the law.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

occurrences.bsb: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
occurrences.kjv: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

occurrences.bsb: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
occurrences.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

occurrences.bsb: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
occurrences.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

occurrences.bsb: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
occurrences.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

occurrences.bsb: Am I suggesting, then, that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
occurrences.kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

occurrences.bsb: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
occurrences.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

occurrences.bsb: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—
occurrences.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
occurrences.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

occurrences.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
occurrences.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

occurrences.bsb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
occurrences.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

occurrences.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
occurrences.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

occurrences.bsb: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
occurrences.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
occurrences.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.

occurrences.bsb: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
occurrences.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

occurrences.bsb: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

occurrences.bsb: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.
occurrences.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
occurrences.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.

occurrences.bsb: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
occurrences.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

occurrences.bsb: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
occurrences.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

occurrences.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
occurrences.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

occurrences.bsb: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
occurrences.kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

occurrences.bsb: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
occurrences.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
