occurrences.bsb: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
occurrences.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

occurrences.bsb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

occurrences.bsb: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
occurrences.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

occurrences.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

occurrences.bsb: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
occurrences.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

occurrences.bsb: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

occurrences.bsb: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
occurrences.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

occurrences.bsb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
occurrences.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

occurrences.bsb: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
occurrences.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

occurrences.bsb: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

occurrences.bsb: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
occurrences.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

occurrences.bsb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
occurrences.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

occurrences.bsb: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
occurrences.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

occurrences.bsb: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

occurrences.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
occurrences.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
occurrences.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
occurrences.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

occurrences.bsb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
occurrences.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

occurrences.bsb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

occurrences.bsb: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
occurrences.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

occurrences.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

occurrences.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
occurrences.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

occurrences.bsb: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
occurrences.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

occurrences.bsb: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
occurrences.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
occurrences.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

occurrences.bsb: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
occurrences.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

occurrences.bsb: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
occurrences.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
occurrences.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

occurrences.bsb: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
occurrences.kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
occurrences.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

occurrences.bsb: For this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
occurrences.kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

occurrences.bsb: as you have already understood us in part, that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” and also “No, no”?
occurrences.kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

occurrences.bsb: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”
occurrences.kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

occurrences.bsb: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
occurrences.kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

occurrences.bsb: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be grieved by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
occurrences.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

occurrences.bsb: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
occurrences.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

occurrences.bsb: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
occurrences.kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

occurrences.bsb: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
occurrences.kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

occurrences.bsb: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

occurrences.bsb: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
occurrences.kjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

occurrences.bsb: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
occurrences.kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

occurrences.bsb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

occurrences.bsb: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
occurrences.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

occurrences.bsb: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
occurrences.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

occurrences.bsb: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
occurrences.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

occurrences.bsb: For while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
occurrences.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

occurrences.bsb: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
occurrences.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

occurrences.bsb: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
occurrences.kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

occurrences.bsb: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
occurrences.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
occurrences.kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

occurrences.bsb: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
occurrences.kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

occurrences.bsb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

occurrences.bsb: And we are sending along with them our brother who has proven his earnestness to us many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
occurrences.kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

occurrences.bsb: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
occurrences.kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

occurrences.bsb: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
occurrences.kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

occurrences.bsb: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
occurrences.kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

occurrences.bsb: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
occurrences.kjv: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

occurrences.bsb: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
occurrences.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

occurrences.bsb: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
occurrences.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

occurrences.bsb: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

occurrences.bsb: For you gladly put up with fools, since you are so wise.
occurrences.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

occurrences.bsb: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
occurrences.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

occurrences.bsb: Are they servants of Christ? (I am speaking as if I were out of my mind.) I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
occurrences.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

occurrences.bsb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
occurrences.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

occurrences.bsb: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
occurrences.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

occurrences.bsb: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

occurrences.bsb: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

occurrences.bsb: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
occurrences.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

occurrences.bsb: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.
occurrences.kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

occurrences.bsb: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you fail the test?
occurrences.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

occurrences.bsb: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
occurrences.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

occurrences.bsb: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
occurrences.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

occurrences.bsb: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
occurrences.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

occurrences.bsb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
occurrences.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

occurrences.bsb: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
occurrences.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

occurrences.bsb: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.
occurrences.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

occurrences.bsb: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:

occurrences.bsb: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”
occurrences.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

occurrences.bsb: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
occurrences.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

occurrences.bsb: But as for the highly esteemed—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—those leaders added nothing to me.
occurrences.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

occurrences.bsb: When Cephas came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
occurrences.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

occurrences.bsb: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
occurrences.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

occurrences.bsb: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
occurrences.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

occurrences.bsb: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
occurrences.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

occurrences.bsb: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
occurrences.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

occurrences.bsb: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
occurrences.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

occurrences.bsb: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
occurrences.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

occurrences.bsb: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
occurrences.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

occurrences.bsb: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
occurrences.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

occurrences.bsb: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

occurrences.bsb: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
occurrences.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

occurrences.bsb: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

occurrences.bsb: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
occurrences.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

occurrences.bsb: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
occurrences.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

occurrences.bsb: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
occurrences.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

occurrences.bsb: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
occurrences.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
occurrences.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

occurrences.bsb: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
occurrences.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

occurrences.bsb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
occurrences.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

occurrences.bsb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

occurrences.bsb: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
occurrences.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

occurrences.bsb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
occurrences.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

occurrences.bsb: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
occurrences.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
occurrences.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

occurrences.bsb: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
occurrences.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

occurrences.bsb: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
occurrences.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

occurrences.bsb: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
occurrences.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

occurrences.bsb: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
occurrences.kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

occurrences.bsb: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
occurrences.kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

occurrences.bsb: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
occurrences.kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

occurrences.bsb: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
occurrences.kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

occurrences.bsb: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
occurrences.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

occurrences.bsb: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
occurrences.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

occurrences.bsb: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
occurrences.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

occurrences.bsb: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
occurrences.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

occurrences.bsb: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
occurrences.kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

occurrences.bsb: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

occurrences.bsb: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
occurrences.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

occurrences.bsb: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
occurrences.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

occurrences.bsb: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
occurrences.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

occurrences.bsb: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
occurrences.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

occurrences.bsb: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
occurrences.kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

occurrences.bsb: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
occurrences.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

occurrences.bsb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
occurrences.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

occurrences.bsb: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
occurrences.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

occurrences.bsb: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
occurrences.kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

occurrences.bsb: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
occurrences.kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

occurrences.bsb: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

occurrences.bsb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
occurrences.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

occurrences.bsb: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
occurrences.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

occurrences.bsb: For we are members of His body.
occurrences.kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

occurrences.bsb: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
occurrences.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

occurrences.bsb: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
occurrences.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

occurrences.bsb: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
occurrences.kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

occurrences.bsb: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

occurrences.bsb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
occurrences.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

occurrences.bsb: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
occurrences.kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

occurrences.bsb: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
occurrences.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

occurrences.bsb: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
occurrences.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

occurrences.bsb: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
occurrences.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
occurrences.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

occurrences.bsb: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
occurrences.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
occurrences.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

occurrences.bsb: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
occurrences.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

occurrences.bsb: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
occurrences.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

occurrences.bsb: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
occurrences.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

occurrences.bsb: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
occurrences.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

occurrences.bsb: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
occurrences.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
occurrences.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

occurrences.bsb: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
occurrences.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

occurrences.bsb: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
occurrences.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

occurrences.bsb: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

occurrences.bsb: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
occurrences.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

occurrences.bsb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
occurrences.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

occurrences.bsb: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
occurrences.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

occurrences.bsb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
occurrences.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

occurrences.bsb: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
occurrences.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

occurrences.bsb: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
occurrences.kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

occurrences.bsb: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
occurrences.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

occurrences.bsb: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
occurrences.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

occurrences.bsb: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
occurrences.kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

occurrences.bsb: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
occurrences.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

occurrences.bsb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

occurrences.bsb: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
occurrences.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

occurrences.bsb: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

occurrences.bsb: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
occurrences.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

occurrences.bsb: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are our glory and joy.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
occurrences.kjv: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
occurrences.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

occurrences.bsb: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
occurrences.kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

occurrences.bsb: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
occurrences.kjv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

occurrences.bsb: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

occurrences.bsb: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
occurrences.kjv: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

occurrences.bsb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
occurrences.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

occurrences.bsb: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
occurrences.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
occurrences.kjv: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

occurrences.bsb: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
occurrences.kjv: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

occurrences.bsb: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

occurrences.bsb: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
occurrences.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

occurrences.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
occurrences.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

occurrences.bsb: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
occurrences.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

occurrences.bsb: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
occurrences.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

occurrences.bsb: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
occurrences.kjv: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

occurrences.bsb: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
occurrences.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

occurrences.bsb: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
occurrences.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

occurrences.bsb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
occurrences.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

occurrences.bsb: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
occurrences.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

occurrences.bsb: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
occurrences.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

occurrences.bsb: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
occurrences.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

occurrences.bsb: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

occurrences.bsb: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
occurrences.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

occurrences.bsb: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

occurrences.bsb: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
occurrences.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
occurrences.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

occurrences.bsb: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
occurrences.kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

occurrences.bsb: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
occurrences.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
occurrences.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

occurrences.bsb: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
occurrences.kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

occurrences.bsb: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.
occurrences.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

occurrences.bsb: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
occurrences.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

occurrences.bsb: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
occurrences.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

occurrences.bsb: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
occurrences.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
occurrences.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

occurrences.bsb: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

occurrences.bsb: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
occurrences.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

occurrences.bsb: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
occurrences.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

occurrences.bsb: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
occurrences.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

occurrences.bsb: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

occurrences.bsb: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
occurrences.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

occurrences.bsb: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
occurrences.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
occurrences.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

occurrences.bsb: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
occurrences.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

occurrences.bsb: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
occurrences.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

occurrences.bsb: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
occurrences.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

occurrences.bsb: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
occurrences.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

occurrences.bsb: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

occurrences.bsb: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
occurrences.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

occurrences.bsb: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

occurrences.bsb: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
occurrences.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

occurrences.bsb: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
occurrences.kjv: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
occurrences.kjv: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

occurrences.bsb: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
occurrences.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
occurrences.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

occurrences.bsb: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?
occurrences.kjv: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

occurrences.bsb: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
occurrences.kjv: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

occurrences.bsb: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
occurrences.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

occurrences.bsb: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
occurrences.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

occurrences.bsb: But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
occurrences.kjv: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

occurrences.bsb: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

occurrences.bsb: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

occurrences.bsb: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
occurrences.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

occurrences.bsb: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
occurrences.kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

occurrences.bsb: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
occurrences.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

occurrences.bsb: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

occurrences.bsb: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
occurrences.kjv: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

occurrences.bsb: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
occurrences.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

occurrences.bsb: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
occurrences.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

occurrences.bsb: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
occurrences.kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

occurrences.bsb: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

occurrences.bsb: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
occurrences.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

occurrences.bsb: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
occurrences.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

occurrences.bsb: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

occurrences.bsb: For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.
occurrences.kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

occurrences.bsb: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
occurrences.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

occurrences.bsb: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
occurrences.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

occurrences.bsb: And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
occurrences.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

occurrences.bsb: Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
occurrences.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

occurrences.bsb: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
occurrences.kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

occurrences.bsb: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
occurrences.kjv: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

occurrences.bsb: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
occurrences.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
