occurrences.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

occurrences.bsb: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
occurrences.kjv: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

occurrences.bsb: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
occurrences.kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

occurrences.bsb: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
occurrences.kjv: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, now that He has died to redeem them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant.
occurrences.kjv: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

occurrences.bsb: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
occurrences.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

occurrences.bsb: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
occurrences.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

occurrences.bsb: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
occurrences.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

occurrences.bsb: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
occurrences.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

occurrences.bsb: And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
occurrences.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

occurrences.bsb: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
occurrences.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
occurrences.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

occurrences.bsb: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
occurrences.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

occurrences.bsb: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
occurrences.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

occurrences.bsb: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
occurrences.kjv: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

occurrences.bsb: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
occurrences.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

occurrences.bsb: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
occurrences.kjv: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

occurrences.bsb: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

occurrences.bsb: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
occurrences.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

occurrences.bsb: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

occurrences.bsb: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
occurrences.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

occurrences.bsb: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
occurrences.kjv: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
occurrences.kjv: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

occurrences.bsb: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
occurrences.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

occurrences.bsb: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
occurrences.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

occurrences.bsb: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
occurrences.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

occurrences.bsb: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
occurrences.kjv: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

occurrences.bsb: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

occurrences.bsb: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
occurrences.kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
occurrences.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

occurrences.bsb: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
occurrences.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

occurrences.bsb: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
occurrences.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

occurrences.bsb: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
occurrences.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
occurrences.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

occurrences.bsb: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
occurrences.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

occurrences.bsb: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
occurrences.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

occurrences.bsb: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
occurrences.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

occurrences.bsb: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
occurrences.kjv: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

occurrences.bsb: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

occurrences.bsb: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
occurrences.kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

occurrences.bsb: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
occurrences.kjv: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

occurrences.bsb: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
occurrences.kjv: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

occurrences.bsb: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
occurrences.kjv: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

occurrences.bsb: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
occurrences.kjv: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
occurrences.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

occurrences.bsb: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
occurrences.kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

occurrences.bsb: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
occurrences.kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

occurrences.bsb: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
occurrences.kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

occurrences.bsb: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
occurrences.kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

occurrences.bsb: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
occurrences.kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
occurrences.kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

occurrences.bsb: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
occurrences.kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

occurrences.bsb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

occurrences.bsb: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
occurrences.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
occurrences.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
occurrences.kjv: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

occurrences.bsb: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
occurrences.kjv: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

occurrences.bsb: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
occurrences.kjv: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

occurrences.bsb: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
occurrences.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

occurrences.bsb: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
occurrences.kjv: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

occurrences.bsb: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
occurrences.kjv: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

occurrences.bsb: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
occurrences.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

occurrences.bsb: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
occurrences.kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

occurrences.bsb: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
occurrences.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
occurrences.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

occurrences.bsb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
occurrences.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

occurrences.bsb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
occurrences.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

occurrences.bsb: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
occurrences.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
occurrences.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
occurrences.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
occurrences.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
occurrences.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
occurrences.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

occurrences.bsb: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
occurrences.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

occurrences.bsb: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

occurrences.bsb: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
occurrences.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

occurrences.bsb: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
occurrences.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

occurrences.bsb: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
occurrences.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

occurrences.bsb: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
occurrences.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

occurrences.bsb: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
occurrences.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
occurrences.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

occurrences.bsb: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

occurrences.bsb: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
occurrences.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

occurrences.bsb: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
occurrences.kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

occurrences.bsb: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
occurrences.kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

occurrences.bsb: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
occurrences.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

occurrences.bsb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
occurrences.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

occurrences.bsb: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
occurrences.kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
occurrences.kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

occurrences.bsb: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
occurrences.kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

occurrences.bsb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
occurrences.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

occurrences.bsb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

occurrences.bsb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
occurrences.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

occurrences.bsb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
occurrences.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

occurrences.bsb: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

occurrences.bsb: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
occurrences.kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

occurrences.bsb: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
occurrences.kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
occurrences.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

occurrences.bsb: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
occurrences.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

occurrences.bsb: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
occurrences.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

occurrences.bsb: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
occurrences.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

occurrences.bsb: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
occurrences.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

occurrences.bsb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
occurrences.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
occurrences.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
occurrences.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

occurrences.bsb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
occurrences.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

occurrences.bsb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
occurrences.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

occurrences.bsb: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
occurrences.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

occurrences.bsb: For there are three that testify:
occurrences.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

occurrences.bsb: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
occurrences.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

occurrences.bsb: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
occurrences.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

occurrences.bsb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

occurrences.bsb: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
occurrences.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

occurrences.bsb: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
occurrences.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

occurrences.bsb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
occurrences.kjv: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

occurrences.bsb: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

occurrences.bsb: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
occurrences.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

occurrences.bsb: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
occurrences.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

occurrences.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
occurrences.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

occurrences.bsb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
occurrences.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

occurrences.bsb: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
occurrences.kjv: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

occurrences.bsb: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
occurrences.kjv: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

occurrences.bsb: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
occurrences.kjv: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

occurrences.bsb: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before His throne,
occurrences.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

occurrences.bsb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
occurrences.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

occurrences.bsb: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
occurrences.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
occurrences.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

occurrences.bsb: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
occurrences.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

occurrences.bsb: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
occurrences.kjv: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

occurrences.bsb: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
occurrences.kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

occurrences.bsb: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

occurrences.bsb: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

occurrences.bsb: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

occurrences.bsb: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

occurrences.bsb: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
occurrences.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

occurrences.bsb: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
occurrences.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

occurrences.bsb: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
occurrences.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

occurrences.bsb: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven spirits of God.
occurrences.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

occurrences.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

occurrences.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

occurrences.bsb: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

occurrences.bsb: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
occurrences.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

occurrences.bsb: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels encircling the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

occurrences.bsb: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.” So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

occurrences.bsb: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
occurrences.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

occurrences.bsb: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
occurrences.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

occurrences.bsb: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
occurrences.kjv: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

occurrences.bsb: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
occurrences.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

occurrences.bsb: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
occurrences.kjv: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

occurrences.bsb: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
occurrences.kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

occurrences.bsb: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

occurrences.bsb: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
occurrences.kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

occurrences.bsb: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
occurrences.kjv: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

occurrences.bsb: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

occurrences.bsb: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.”
occurrences.kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

occurrences.bsb: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
occurrences.kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

occurrences.bsb: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

occurrences.bsb: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
occurrences.kjv: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

occurrences.bsb: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
occurrences.kjv: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

occurrences.bsb: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. But when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
occurrences.kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

occurrences.bsb: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
occurrences.kjv: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

occurrences.bsb: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast.
occurrences.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

occurrences.bsb: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
occurrences.kjv: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

occurrences.bsb: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
occurrences.kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

occurrences.bsb: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
occurrences.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

occurrences.bsb: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

occurrences.bsb: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
occurrences.kjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

occurrences.bsb: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

occurrences.bsb: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

occurrences.bsb: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

occurrences.bsb: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.
occurrences.kjv: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

occurrences.bsb: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
occurrences.kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

occurrences.bsb: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
occurrences.kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

occurrences.bsb: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
occurrences.kjv: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

occurrences.bsb: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”
occurrences.kjv: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

occurrences.bsb: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.
occurrences.kjv: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

occurrences.bsb: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
occurrences.kjv: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

occurrences.bsb: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
occurrences.kjv: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

occurrences.bsb: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
occurrences.kjv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

occurrences.bsb: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

occurrences.bsb: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
occurrences.kjv: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

occurrences.bsb: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

occurrences.bsb: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
occurrences.kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

occurrences.bsb: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

occurrences.bsb: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

occurrences.bsb: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
occurrences.kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
